mechanism: Decode JSON objects as ordered raw key/value pair frames. Traverse child frames before their retained parent frame. A serialized recurrence checkpoint stores the original fixed source, the set of already-processed frame paths, the already-emitted collision event ledger, and the next frame path. On reconstruction, rebuild raw pair frames from source and skip every processed frame before scanning unprocessed frames.
tested_scope: Exactly one fixed-source deterministic local recurrence control. The checkpoint is taken after both child object frames have been scanned and after the second-sibling NFC collision has been recorded, but before the outer parent frame is scanned. The control tests only whether source-plus-processed-frame-paths-plus-event-ledger reconstruction skips the processed second sibling and produces the retained outer-parent collision exactly once.
observation: Fresh reconstruction from the serialized checkpoint retained one and only one second-sibling collision event and then produced one and only one outer-parent collision. The processed-frame set prevented re-scanning the already-completed second sibling while the retained raw-pair source allowed the parent frame to remain reconstructible after process loss.
scope_guard: Positive evidence is limited to this one fixed-source restart boundary. It does not prove crash consistency if interruption occurs between emitting a frame event and marking that frame processed, arbitrary parser restart safety, arbitrary Unicode classes, hostile-size bounds, or Phase-1 closure.
exact_next_action: Next valid invocation: after fresh authority freeze, own-state reconstruction, and required persisted/read-back preflight, execute exactly one deterministic ambiguous-boundary control on the same fixed source and scanner representation: serialize a checkpoint immediately after the outer-parent collision event has been appended to the event ledger but before the outer-parent frame path is marked processed, reconstruct in fresh local state, and determine only whether naive resume duplicates the outer-parent event. If duplication occurs, record it as an exact-scope counterexample; do not design or test the fix in that same invocation.
